title: English Practice Quiz 0918
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A task that is both important and urgent should generally be ___.
questions.explanation: handled promptly is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A realistic schedule should include ___.
options: time for tasks and reasonable breaks
questions.explanation: time for tasks and reasonable breaks is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A deadline is ___.
options: the date a task was invented
the latest time by which work is due
questions.explanation: the latest time by which work is due is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Batching similar tasks can reduce ___.
questions.explanation: time lost switching between activities is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: When priorities conflict, first clarify ___.
questions.explanation: urgency, impact and dependencies is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A project milestone marks ___.
questions.explanation: an important stage or checkpoint is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Delegation means ___.
options: assigning a task or responsibility to another person
questions.explanation: assigning a task or responsibility to another person is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A schedule buffer provides ___.
questions.explanation: extra time for unexpected delays is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Reviewing a task list regularly helps ___.
questions.explanation: update priorities and track progress is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a deadline may be missed, you should ___.
options: inform the relevant person early and propose a plan
questions.explanation: inform the relevant person early and propose a plan is the correct choice based on the meaning and context of the question.
